issues_ranked.title: Relative include path from msgpack-c breaks cmake configuration
issues_ranked.description: pkg-config returns relative path 'include' for MSGPACK_INCLUDE_DIRS, which propagates through PUBLIC link chains, causing CMake errors about relative INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES on every target.

issues_ranked.title: #embed directive not supported by available compilers
issues_ranked.description: Uses C++23 #embed directive which is not supported by GCC 14 or Clang 17 (the available compilers).

issues_ranked.title: C++20 modules use clang-specific --precompile flag
issues_ranked.description: Module compilation uses --precompile which is clang-specific. GCC uses -fmodules-ts with a different workflow.

issues_ranked.title: libstdc++ 14 + clang 17 incompatibility with unordered_map operations
issues_ranked.description: operator[] and try_emplace on std::unordered_map fail with clang 17 + libstdc++ 14 due to std::get template resolution failure.
